summary: Horizon Quantum Holdings (Nasdaq: HQ), a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing a non-binding letter of intent, signed November 5, 2026, to acquire Entropica Labs Pte. Ltd., a Singapore private quantum-software company focused on error correction and fault tolerance. Anticipated consideration is $27 million, payable entirely in Horizon Quantum Class A ordinary shares. No price per share, premium, exchange ratio, board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The deal is expressly non-binding and conditioned on due diligence, related audits, definitive agreements and customary conditions. Watch for definitive signing, stock consideration dilution/overhang, audit completion and any renegotiation risk, given the preliminary stage.
